name: Barbell bench press
cue: Pin your shoulder blades back and drive the bar up over your chest.
howTo: Lie with eyes under the bar, feet planted, shoulder blades squeezed together and down.
Unrack, lower the bar to the lower chest with forearms vertical, then press back up and slightly toward the rack.
Finish with elbows locked and the bar stacked over your shoulders.
Lower for about two seconds, pause briefly, breathe in on the way down and out as you press.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Letting the shoulder blades slide forward and the shoulders roll up.
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides.

name: Incline barbell bench press
cue: Press from the upper chest in a straight line over the shoulders.
howTo: Set the bench to a low incline, lie back with shoulder blades pinched and feet flat.
Lower the bar to the top of the chest, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso, then press it back up.
Finish with locked elbows and the bar directly over the shoulder joint.
Two seconds down, no bounce, and exhale through the hardest part of the press.
mistakes: Setting the bench so steep it turns into a shoulder press.
Lifting the hips off the pad to move more weight.
Lowering the bar to the neck instead of the upper chest.

name: Dumbbell bench press
cue: Get a deep stretch at the bottom and squeeze the dumbbells together at the top.
howTo: Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs, lie back and kick them up to chest level, shoulder blades pinched.
Lower with elbows about 45 degrees from the torso until you feel a stretch across the chest, then press up.
Finish with the dumbbells over your shoulders and arms straight, not clanking together.
Control the descent for two seconds and breathe out as you press.
mistakes: Dropping the elbows so low the shoulders strain.
Letting the dumbbells drift wide and wobble.
Cutting the range short to use heavier weights.

name: Incline dumbbell press
cue: Press up and slightly in, keeping the work in the upper chest.
howTo: Set the bench to a low incline, kick the dumbbells up and pin the shoulder blades to the pad.
Lower to the sides of your upper chest with a comfortable stretch, then press up and together.
Finish with straight arms and the dumbbells above the shoulders.
Take two seconds on the way down and exhale as you drive up.
mistakes: Using a steep incline that hands the work to the shoulders.
Arching the lower back off the pad.
Letting the dumbbells crash together at the top.

name: Machine chest press
cue: Press the handles forward as if pushing the floor away from your chest.
howTo: Set the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest, back flat against the pad.
Press forward until your arms are nearly straight, then return slowly until you feel the chest stretch.
Finish with a firm squeeze and elbows just short of lockout.
Two seconds back, breathe out on the push.
mistakes: Setting the seat too low so the shoulders roll forward.
Shrugging toward the ears as you press.
Letting the weight stack slam at the bottom.

name: Plate-loaded chest press
cue: Drive through the handles and let each arm do its own work.
howTo: Sit tall with the handles at mid-chest height and your back firmly on the pad.
Push both handles out until the arms are nearly straight, then bring them back under control.
Finish with a short squeeze and soft elbows.
Smooth two second return, exhale on the push.
mistakes: Letting one arm lead and the other lag behind.
Lifting the back off the pad to shove the weight.
Loading too many plates and shortening the range.

name: Plate-loaded incline press
cue: Press up on the angle and keep the upper chest tight.
howTo: Adjust the seat so the handles start at upper chest height with your back flat.
Press up and forward until the arms are nearly straight, then lower slowly to a stretch.
Finish with the handles over the shoulder line and the chest squeezed.
Two seconds down, exhale as you push.
mistakes: Starting with the handles too low and straining the shoulders.
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides.
Locking out hard and resting on the joints.

name: Pec deck
cue: Hug a big tree and squeeze the chest at the centre.
howTo: Sit with your back flat, handles level with the chest and a slight bend in the elbows.
Bring the handles together in a wide arc, then let them open until the chest is stretched.
Finish with the handles meeting in front of the chest and a one second squeeze.
Open slowly over three seconds and breathe out as you close.
mistakes: Opening the arms so far behind the body that the shoulders ache.
Turning the movement into a press by bending the elbows more and more.
Rushing the return so the stack slams.

name: Cable crossover
cue: Sweep the handles together in an arc and finish with a chest squeeze.
howTo: Set both pulleys high, step forward into a split stance with a slight bend in the elbows and a tall chest.
Sweep the handles down and in until they meet in front of your lower chest.
Finish with hands together and the chest fully contracted.
Open slowly for three seconds, exhale on the way in.
mistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows so it becomes a press.
Leaning and swinging the body to move the handles.
Letting the cables pull the shoulders far back at the open position.

name: Push-up
cue: Keep the body one straight plank and bring the chest to the floor.
howTo: Set hands just wider than the shoulders, feet together, body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower the chest to just above the floor with elbows about 45 degrees from the torso, then push up.
Finish with locked elbows and the shoulder blades wrapped around the ribs.
One to two seconds down, exhale as you push away from the floor.
mistakes: Sagging the hips or piking them up.
Flaring the elbows to a T shape.
Stopping halfway down.

name: Barbell row
cue: Hinge forward and row the bar to your belly with a flat back.
howTo: Hinge at the hips until the torso is near 45 degrees, bar hanging below the shoulders, back flat.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs by driving the elbows behind you.
Finish with the shoulder blades squeezed and the bar touching the belly.
Lower in two seconds, breathe out on the pull and keep the brace the whole set.
mistakes: Standing up with each rep and heaving the weight.
Rounding the lower back.
Pulling to the chest and shrugging instead of rowing.

name: Deadlift
cue: Push the floor away and keep the bar dragging up your legs.
howTo: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, grip just outside the knees, shins to the bar, chest up and back flat.
Take the slack out of the bar, brace hard and push the floor away until the bar passes the knees, then drive the hips forward.
Finish standing tall with glutes squeezed, without leaning back.
Breathe in and brace before each pull, control the bar back down the legs, and reset every rep.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back off the floor.
Letting the bar swing away from the legs.
Yanking the bar instead of building tension first.

name: Trap bar deadlift
cue: Stand inside the bar and push the floor away with a proud chest.
howTo: Step inside the bar, feet hip-width apart, grip the neutral handles, hips lower than the shoulders and back flat.
Brace, push through the whole foot and stand up with the bar close to your body.
Finish tall with hips and knees locked and the shoulders over the hips.
Breathe in before the pull, control the lowering and reset each rep.
mistakes: Turning it into a squat by dropping the hips too low.
Jerking the weight off the floor.
Leaning back at the top.

name: Pull-up
cue: Pull your elbows down to your ribs and lead with the chest.
howTo: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than the shoulders and the shoulder blades drawn down.
Pull until your chin clears the bar by driving the elbows toward your ribs.
Finish with the chest high and the bar near the collarbone.
Lower for two to three seconds to a full hang and breathe out as you pull.
mistakes: Kipping or swinging for momentum.
Stopping short of a full hang at the bottom.
Craning the neck to get the chin over the bar.

name: Assisted pull-up
cue: Let the machine carry part of you while the lats do the pulling.
howTo: Pick a stack weight, kneel or stand on the pad and take a grip slightly wider than the shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving the elbows down and back.
Finish with the chin above the handles and the shoulder blades down.
Lower in two to three seconds and breathe out as you pull.
mistakes: Using so much assistance that the lats barely work.
Swinging the legs to get up.
Cutting the bottom of the rep short.

name: Lat pulldown
cue: Drive your elbows down into your back pockets and keep the chest tall.
howTo: Sit with the thighs locked under the pads, grip the bar a little wider than shoulder width and lean back slightly.
Pull the bar to your upper chest by driving the elbows down and back.
Finish with the bar at the collarbone and the shoulder blades pulled down.
Let the bar rise for two to three seconds until the arms are long, and breathe out as you pull.
mistakes: Leaning far back and rocking the weight down.
Pulling the bar behind the neck.
Letting the shoulders shrug up at the top of the rep.

name: Seated cable row
cue: Row the handle to your belly and squeeze the shoulder blades together.
howTo: Sit tall with feet braced, knees slightly bent and the handle held with arms straight.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs while keeping the torso upright.
Finish with the elbows behind the body and the shoulder blades squeezed.
Return slowly for two seconds until the shoulders stretch forward, exhaling on the pull.
mistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth to move the weight.
Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.
Rounding the lower back at the stretch.

name: Single-arm cable row
cue: Row one side at a time and keep the hips square.
howTo: Sit or stand facing the cable with a single handle, feet braced, torso tall and shoulders level.
Pull the handle to your side by driving the elbow past the ribs.
Finish with the elbow behind you and the shoulder blade pulled in.
Return slowly over two seconds and breathe out on the pull.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to cheat the weight back.
Letting the shoulder shrug up.
Cutting the stretch short at the front.

name: Chest-supported machine row
cue: Press your chest into the pad and pull your elbows past the ribs.
howTo: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and rest the chest firmly on the pad.
Pull the handles back by driving the elbows behind the torso.
Finish with the shoulder blades squeezed and the chest still on the pad.
Return for two seconds to a full stretch, exhaling on the pull.
mistakes: Pulling the chest off the pad to gain momentum.
Shrugging instead of retracting.
Stopping the return before the arms are long.

name: Plate-loaded iso-lateral row
cue: Row each arm independently and finish with the elbow past the torso.
howTo: Set the seat so the handles sit at mid-chest and the chest rests on the pad if there is one.
Pull the handles back toward your hips, leading with the elbows.
Finish with the shoulder blades together and the lats squeezed.
Take two seconds returning to a full stretch and breathe out on the pull.
mistakes: Letting the stronger arm take over.
Heaving the torso backward to finish the rep.
Stopping the stretch short.

name: Plate-loaded high row
cue: Pull down and back like a pulldown with a seated base.
howTo: Sit with the chest on the pad, grip the handles overhead with a slight lean back.
Pull the handles down and back, driving the elbows toward the hips.
Finish with the elbows beside the ribs and the shoulder blades pulled down.
Return slowly for two to three seconds to a full stretch, exhaling on the pull.
mistakes: Shrugging up into the ears at the top.
Leaning back too far to cheat.
Letting the plates yank the arms up quickly.

name: Dumbbell row
cue: Pull the dumbbell to your hip as if starting a lawn mower.
howTo: Place one knee and hand on a bench, back flat, other foot on the floor and the dumbbell hanging under the shoulder.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping the elbow close to the body.
Finish with the shoulder blade squeezed and the elbow past the torso.
Lower for two seconds to a full stretch and breathe out on the pull.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to swing the weight up.
Pulling toward the chest and shrugging.
Letting the back round as the dumbbell lowers.

name: Straight-arm pulldown
cue: Sweep the bar to your thighs with straight arms and a tight lat.
howTo: Stand facing a high cable with a bar or rope, hinge slightly forward and keep the arms nearly straight.
Push the bar down in an arc until it touches the thighs.
Finish with the lats squeezed and the arms still almost straight.
Let the bar rise slowly for three seconds and exhale on the way down.
mistakes: Bending the elbows so it turns into a triceps pushdown.
Swinging the whole body into the movement.
Letting the bar float away from the body.

name: Back extension
cue: Hinge from the hips and rise only until the body is straight.
howTo: Set the pad just below the hip bones, lock your heels in and cross the arms over your chest.
Lower the torso by hinging at the hips with a flat back until you feel the hamstrings stretch.
Finish by raising the torso until it forms a straight line with the legs.
Take two seconds up and two seconds down, exhaling as you rise.
mistakes: Hyperextending the lower back past a straight line.
Rounding the spine at the bottom.
Swinging up using momentum.

name: Overhead press
cue: Brace tight and press the bar in a straight line over your head.
howTo: Hold the bar at the collarbone with elbows slightly in front, glutes squeezed and ribs down.
Press the bar up, moving your head back then through as the bar passes the forehead.
Finish with the bar over the middle of the foot, arms locked and shoulders shrugged up.
Breathe in and brace before each press, lower the bar under control to the collarbone.
mistakes: Leaning back into a standing incline press.
Pressing the bar forward in an arc.
Letting the elbows drift far behind the bar.

name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
cue: Press the dumbbells straight up with the ribs down and core tight.
howTo: Sit with the back against the bench, dumbbells at ear height and forearms vertical.
Press the dumbbells overhead until the arms are straight and close to touching.
Finish with the dumbbells above the shoulders and the ribs still down.
Lower for two seconds to ear level and breathe out as you press.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the bench.
Letting the elbows flare far behind the body.
Lowering the dumbbells only halfway.

name: Machine shoulder press
cue: Press up from the shoulders and keep the neck relaxed.
howTo: Set the seat so the handles start near shoulder height and your back is flat on the pad.
Press the handles up until the arms are nearly straight.
Finish without locking out hard and without shrugging into the ears.
Lower in two seconds and exhale as you press.
mistakes: Setting the seat so low the shoulders pinch.
Arching the back to push more weight.
Slamming the weight stack on every rep.

name: Plate-loaded shoulder press
cue: Push each handle straight up and stay tall in the seat.
howTo: Sit with your back flat and the handles at shoulder height.
Press both handles overhead with the elbows under the wrists.
Finish with arms nearly straight and ribs down.
Return slowly for two seconds and breathe out as you press.
mistakes: Letting one arm lead and the other trail.
Leaning back to turn it into an incline press.
Bouncing at the bottom.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
cue: Lead with the elbows and lift to shoulder height, no higher.
howTo: Stand tall with a slight bend in the elbows and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise the arms out to the sides, elbows leading, until the upper arms are level with the shoulders.
Finish with a slight tilt of the hands and no shrug.
Lower for three seconds and breathe out on the way up.
mistakes: Swinging the body to heave the dumbbells up.
Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.
Lifting the hands well above shoulder height.

name: Cable lateral raise
cue: Pull the cable out in an arc with the elbow, not the wrist.
howTo: Stand side-on to a low pulley, hold the handle with the far hand and keep a soft elbow.
Raise the arm out and up to shoulder height, leading with the elbow.
Finish with the upper arm level and the shoulder relaxed.
Lower in three seconds and exhale as you lift.
mistakes: Swaying the torso away from the stack.
Lifting with the wrist and forearm instead of the elbow.
Letting the shoulder shrug up.

name: Machine lateral raise
cue: Push the pads out with your elbows and keep the shoulders down.
howTo: Sit with your back on the pad, set the seat so the pads rest on your lower arms near the elbows.
Raise the arms out to the sides until they are about level with the shoulders.
Finish with the shoulders low and the side delts tight.
Lower in three seconds and exhale on the raise.
mistakes: Shrugging as the arms rise.
Pushing with the hands rather than the elbows.
Letting the stack drop between reps.

name: Reverse pec deck
cue: Open the arms wide and squeeze the back of the shoulders.
howTo: Face the pad, chest against it, handles at shoulder height and a slight bend in the elbows.
Sweep the arms back and out in a wide arc.
Finish with the arms in line with the shoulders and the shoulder blades gently squeezed.
Return slowly for three seconds and breathe out as you open.
mistakes: Going so heavy that the traps take over.
Pulling the hands behind the back.
Letting the stack crash between reps.

name: Face pull
cue: Pull the rope to your forehead and spread the ends apart.
howTo: Set the pulley at upper chest or face height with a rope, step back and hold the ends with thumbs toward you.
Pull the rope toward your face, pulling the hands apart and the elbows high.
Finish with the hands beside the ears and the shoulder blades squeezed.
Return slowly for two to three seconds and exhale as you pull.
mistakes: Using so much weight that the torso leans back.
Dropping the elbows below the hands.
Pulling to the chest instead of the face.

name: Barbell curl
cue: Keep the elbows pinned and curl the bar up without swinging.
howTo: Stand tall holding the bar at shoulder width with an underhand grip and elbows by your ribs.
Curl the bar up by bending only at the elbows.
Finish with the bar near the shoulders and the biceps squeezed.
Lower for three seconds to full extension and breathe out as you curl.
mistakes: Swinging the hips to throw the bar up.
Letting the elbows drift forward.
Cutting the range short at the bottom.

name: EZ bar curl
cue: Curl the bar up with a wrist-friendly angle and quiet elbows.
howTo: Hold the EZ bar on the angled grips with an underhand hold, elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Finish with the biceps squeezed and the wrists straight.
Lower under control for three seconds and exhale as you curl.
mistakes: Rocking the torso backward to get the bar up.
Gripping too wide and straining the wrists.
Letting the elbows travel forward.

name: Dumbbell curl
cue: Curl and slightly turn the palm up, elbow glued to the side.
howTo: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward and elbows next to your ribs.
Curl the dumbbell up, turning the little finger toward the shoulder.
Finish with the biceps contracted and the elbow still at your side.
Lower for three seconds and exhale as you curl.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weights.
Letting the elbows drift forward and up.
Dropping the dumbbell without control.

name: Hammer curl
cue: Keep the thumbs up and curl as if hammering a nail.
howTo: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other and elbows tucked.
Curl the dumbbell up toward the shoulder without twisting the wrist.
Finish with the forearm vertical and the biceps squeezed.
Lower slowly for three seconds and breathe out as you curl.
mistakes: Swinging the back to cheat the weight.
Letting the elbow slide forward.
Rotating the wrist during the lift.

name: Incline dumbbell curl
cue: Let the arms hang behind you to stretch the biceps, then curl up.
howTo: Sit back on a bench inclined to about 60 degrees with arms hanging straight down.
Curl both dumbbells up without moving the upper arms forward.
Finish with the biceps contracted and the elbows still back.
Lower slowly for three seconds to a full stretch and exhale as you curl.
mistakes: Letting the elbows swing forward and losing the stretch.
Sitting up off the bench to help.
Using a weight so heavy that the shoulders roll forward.

name: Machine preacher curl
cue: Rest your upper arms on the pad and curl through the full range.
howTo: Set the seat so your armpits touch the top of the pad and the elbows line up with the pivot.
Curl the handles up toward the shoulders.
Finish with the biceps squeezed and the upper arms still on the pad.
Lower in three seconds to nearly straight arms and exhale as you curl.
mistakes: Lifting the elbows off the pad.
Stopping short of full extension at the bottom.
Using the shoulders to heave the weight.

name: Cable curl
cue: The cable keeps tension on the biceps from start to finish.
howTo: Face the low pulley with a straight or EZ attachment, elbows by your ribs and chest tall.
Curl the handle up by bending only at the elbows.
Finish with the biceps squeezed and the elbows still at your sides.
Lower for three seconds and exhale as you curl.
mistakes: Leaning back to turn the curl into a swing.
Letting the elbows move forward.
Resting at the bottom with the stack touching.

name: Cable pushdown
cue: Elbows stay pinned at your sides while the forearms do the work.
howTo: Stand facing a high pulley, grip the bar or rope, elbows tucked and chest tall.
Push the attachment down until the arms are straight.
Finish with the triceps squeezed and the elbows still at the sides.
Let the handle rise for two to three seconds to about chest height and exhale as you push.
mistakes: Letting the elbows flare away from the body.
Leaning over the handle to push with body weight.
Cutting the top of the rep short.

name: Overhead cable extension
cue: Stretch the long head by reaching the elbows up and forward.
howTo: Face away from a low or mid pulley holding a rope behind your head, split stance and ribs down.
Extend the elbows until the arms are straight overhead.
Finish with the triceps squeezed and the upper arms still near the ears.
Lower for three seconds to a deep stretch and exhale as you extend.
mistakes: Letting the elbows flare wide.
Arching the lower back as the arms rise.
Moving the upper arms instead of just the elbows.

name: Skull crusher
cue: Lower the bar behind your head and keep the upper arms still.
howTo: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar over the chest with arms straight and elbows pointing up.
Bend the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind your head.
Finish by extending until the arms are straight above the shoulders.
Lower in three seconds and exhale as you extend.
mistakes: Letting the elbows flare wide.
Drifting the upper arms back and forth so it becomes a press.
Going too heavy and losing control near the head.

name: Dip
cue: Lower until the shoulders reach elbow height, then press back up.
howTo: Hold yourself on parallel bars with straight arms, shoulders down and a slight forward lean.
Bend the elbows to lower the body until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Finish with locked elbows and the chest high.
Lower in two seconds and exhale as you press up.
mistakes: Sinking so deep that the shoulders roll forward.
Swinging the legs to gain momentum.
Cutting the reps short at the top.

name: Assisted dip
cue: Let the machine take some weight and press with straight lines.
howTo: Set the assistance weight, kneel on the pad and hold the handles with straight arms.
Lower the body by bending the elbows until the upper arms reach parallel.
Finish by pressing to straight arms with the chest high.
Take two seconds down and exhale as you press.
mistakes: Using too much help and getting little from the set.
Letting the shoulders roll forward at the bottom.
Bouncing out of the bottom position.

name: Machine triceps extension
cue: Press the handles down and squeeze the triceps at the bottom.
howTo: Set the seat so your upper arms rest comfortably on the pad and the elbows line up with the pivot.
Extend the arms by pushing the handles down or forward.
Finish with the arms straight and the triceps squeezed.
Return in three seconds and exhale on the push.
mistakes: Lifting the elbows off the pad.
Using the shoulders to shove the weight.
Stopping before the arms are straight.

name: Close-grip bench press
cue: Hands just inside shoulder width and elbows tucked.
howTo: Lie on the bench with a grip about shoulder width, shoulder blades pinched and feet planted.
Lower the bar to the lower chest with the elbows close to the sides, then press up.
Finish with the elbows locked and the bar over the shoulders.
Lower for two seconds and breathe out as you press.
mistakes: Using a grip so narrow that the wrists bend.
Flaring the elbows out.
Bouncing the bar off the chest.

name: Dumbbell wrist curl
cue: Roll the dumbbell up using only your wrist.
howTo: Sit with forearms resting on your thighs or a bench, palms up, wrists hanging past the edge.
Curl the dumbbell up by bending the wrist toward you.
Finish with the forearm flexors squeezed and the forearm still on the support.
Lower slowly for three seconds to a full stretch and breathe normally.
mistakes: Lifting the forearms off the support.
Using a weight too heavy to control the lowering.
Moving only a small part of the range.

name: Reverse curl
cue: Palms down, elbows still, curl without bending the wrists.
howTo: Hold an EZ bar with an overhand grip, elbows by your ribs and wrists straight.
Curl the bar up toward the shoulders without letting the wrists bend back.
Finish with the forearms squeezed and the elbows still.
Lower for three seconds and exhale as you curl.
mistakes: Letting the wrists bend back under the load.
Swinging the torso to get the bar up.
Using more weight than the grip can control.

name: Farmer's walk
cue: Stand tall, grip hard and walk with short steady steps.
howTo: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand using a hinge, then stand tall with the shoulders back and ribs down.
Walk forward with short steady steps, keeping the dumbbells from swinging.
Finish by lowering the dumbbells under control with a hinge, not a drop.
Breathe normally, keep the core braced and keep the gaze forward.
mistakes: Leaning to one side as you walk.
Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.
Taking long bouncy steps that swing the weights.

name: Back squat
cue: Brace, sit between your hips and drive the floor away.
howTo: Set the bar on your upper back, feet shoulder width with toes slightly out, ribs down and core braced.
Sit down and back, keeping the knees tracking over the toes, to at least parallel.
Finish standing tall with the hips and knees fully extended.
Breathe in at the top, brace, take about two seconds down and drive up without rushing.
mistakes: Letting the knees cave in.
Rounding the lower back at the bottom.
Rising with the hips first so the chest drops forward.

name: Front squat
cue: Keep the elbows high and the torso upright.
howTo: Rest the bar on the front of the shoulders with elbows high, feet shoulder width and core braced.
Sit straight down, keeping the chest up and the elbows high.
Finish by standing tall without letting the elbows drop.
Breathe in before each rep, brace and take two seconds down.
mistakes: Letting the elbows drop and the bar roll forward.
Leaning forward and rounding the upper back.
Letting the knees collapse inward.

name: Leg press
cue: Press through the whole foot without letting the lower back peel up.
howTo: Sit with the back and hips flat on the pad and the feet shoulder width on the platform.
Unlock the safeties, lower the sled until the knees are near the chest, then press back up.
Finish with the legs nearly straight and the knees soft.
Take two seconds down and exhale as you press.
mistakes: Letting the hips roll up and the lower back lift at the bottom.
Locking the knees hard at the top.
Placing the feet so low that the heels lift.

name: Hack squat
cue: Slide down with your back on the pad and push through mid-foot.
howTo: Stand on the platform with the shoulders under the pads and the back flat, feet shoulder width.
Lower under control until the thighs are at least parallel, then press back up.
Finish with the legs almost straight and the knees soft.
Take two seconds down and exhale as you press.
mistakes: Letting the heels lift at the bottom.
Dropping the knees inward.
Bouncing out of the bottom.

name: Smith machine squat
cue: The bar is guided, so choose your foot position and keep the torso steady.
howTo: Set the bar on your upper back, feet slightly forward of the bar and core braced.
Sit down until the thighs are at least parallel, then press back up.
Finish standing tall without a violent lockout.
Take two seconds down and exhale as you drive up.
mistakes: Standing with the feet directly under the bar and leaning back.
Rounding the lower back at the bottom.
Letting the heels lift.

name: Leg extension
cue: Straighten the knee fully and squeeze the quads at the top.
howTo: Sit back with the knees in line with the machine pivot and the pad on your lower shins.
Extend the knees until the legs are straight.
Finish with the quads squeezed for a one second hold.
Lower for three seconds and exhale as you extend.
mistakes: Swinging the weight up with momentum.
Letting the hips lift off the seat.
Dropping the weight on the way down.

name: Bulgarian split squat
cue: Drop straight down and keep the front foot planted.
howTo: Rest the back foot on a bench, step the front foot out so the shin can stay near vertical, dumbbells at your sides.
Lower the back knee toward the floor until the front thigh is near parallel.
Finish by driving through the front foot to stand tall.
Take two seconds down, breathe out as you rise, and finish all reps before switching legs.
mistakes: Standing too close and letting the front knee shoot far forward.
Leaning the torso forward and rounding the back.
Pushing off the back foot instead of the front leg.

name: Walking lunge
cue: Take a long step and drop the back knee straight down.
howTo: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, stand tall and take a long step forward.
Lower the back knee toward the floor until the front thigh is near parallel.
Finish by driving through the front foot and stepping the rear foot through.
Breathe out as you rise and keep the torso upright throughout.
mistakes: Taking steps too short so the front knee shoots forward.
Letting the front knee cave inward.
Rushing the steps so you wobble from side to side.

name: Goblet squat
cue: Hold the weight at your chest and sit down between your knees.
howTo: Hold one dumbbell vertically at your chest, elbows pointing down, feet shoulder width and toes slightly out.
Sit down between your hips, keeping the chest tall, until the thighs are at least parallel.
Finish by standing tall and squeezing the glutes.
Breathe in on the way down, brace, and exhale as you stand.
mistakes: Letting the weight drift forward and the torso fold.
Letting the knees cave in.
Rising on the toes as you squat.

name: Step-up
cue: Drive through the lead foot and stand all the way up.
howTo: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, put one foot fully on a bench or box so the thigh is near parallel.
Press through that foot to stand up, bringing the other knee up without pushing off the floor.
Finish standing tall on the bench with the hips under you.
Lower slowly for two seconds and finish all reps on one leg before switching.
mistakes: Pushing hard off the back foot.
Using a bench so high that the back rounds.
Letting the front knee cave in.

name: Romanian deadlift
cue: Push the hips back and slide the bar down your thighs.
howTo: Stand with the bar at hip height, feet hip width, knees slightly bent and shoulder blades back.
Push the hips straight back, sliding the bar down the thighs until you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Finish by driving the hips forward to stand tall with glutes squeezed.
Take about three seconds down, breathe in at the top and brace before the descent.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back to chase depth.
Bending the knees and squatting down.
Letting the bar drift away from the legs.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cue: Hips back, dumbbells close, flat back.
howTo: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, feet hip width and knees slightly bent.
Push the hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs until the hamstrings stretch.
Finish by driving the hips forward to stand tall.
Take three seconds down and exhale as you stand.
mistakes: Rounding the back as the dumbbells go low.
Letting the dumbbells swing away from the legs.
Bending the knees until it becomes a squat.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
cue: Square the hips and hinge on one leg like a seesaw.
howTo: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand, slight knee bend and hips square.
Hinge forward, sending the free leg straight back, until the torso is near parallel to the floor.
Finish by driving the hips forward to stand tall on the working leg.
Take three seconds down, exhale as you rise and keep a light touch on a support if needed.
mistakes: Letting the hips open up and rotate.
Rounding the back to reach the floor.
Hopping on the standing foot to regain balance.

name: Seated leg curl
cue: Curl the pad under you and squeeze the hamstrings.
howTo: Sit with your back flat against the pad, the thigh pad snug and the ankle pad just above the heels.
Curl the legs down and back as far as you can.
Finish with the hamstrings squeezed and the knees fully bent.
Return slowly for three seconds and exhale as you curl.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the seat.
Using momentum to swing the pad.
Cutting the stretch short at the top.

name: Lying leg curl
cue: Curl your heels to your glutes without the hips popping up.
howTo: Lie face down with the pad on the lower calves, hips pressed down and knees just off the bench edge.
Curl the heels toward your glutes.
Finish with the hamstrings squeezed and the hips still pressed down.
Lower for three seconds to nearly straight legs and exhale as you curl.
mistakes: Raising the hips to cheat the weight up.
Dropping the weight in the last part of the rep.
Stopping short of the full stretch.

name: Good morning
cue: Push the hips back with a flat back and a bar on the shoulders.
howTo: Set the bar on your upper back, feet hip width and knees slightly bent.
Push the hips straight back and lower the torso until you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Finish by driving the hips forward to stand tall.
Take three seconds down, breathe in before each rep, and keep the load moderate.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back under the load.
Bending the knees until it becomes a squat.
Going so heavy that the bar rolls or the back gives way.

name: Nordic hamstring curl
cue: Lower yourself as slowly as you can and catch the floor with your hands.
howTo: Kneel on a pad with the ankles locked under a bar or held by a partner, body straight from knees to head.
Lower the torso forward as slowly as you can by straightening at the knees.
Finish by catching yourself with your hands and pushing back up to the start.
Take at least three seconds down and keep the hips extended throughout.
mistakes: Folding at the hips instead of keeping the body straight.
Dropping fast and giving up control.
Not keeping the ankles locked.

name: Barbell hip thrust
cue: Tuck your chin, drive through the heels and squeeze the glutes.
howTo: Rest your upper back on a bench with the bar across the hips, feet flat and shins vertical at the top.
Drive through the heels and lift the hips until the body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Finish with a one second squeeze and ribs down, not an arched back.
Lower in two seconds and exhale as you thrust.
mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top.
Pushing through the toes with the knees caving.
Setting the feet too far away so the hamstrings take over.

name: Machine hip thrust
cue: Ribs down, chin tucked, press the hips up with the glutes.
howTo: Sit with the pad across your hips, upper back on the support and feet flat.
Drive through the heels and lift the hips until the thighs are level with the torso.
Finish with a squeeze and no arching of the lower back.
Lower in two seconds and exhale as you thrust.
mistakes: Overarching the back to gain height.
Letting the feet slide forward.
Rushing the descent.

name: Glute bridge
cue: Squeeze the glutes and lift the hips in a straight line.
howTo: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat near your hips and arms at your sides.
Press through the heels and lift the hips until the body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Finish with a one second squeeze of the glutes.
Lower in two seconds and exhale as you lift.
mistakes: Pushing through the toes and straining the lower back.
Overarching at the top.
Letting the knees cave inward.

name: Cable kickback
cue: Kick straight back and squeeze the glute without arching.
howTo: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley, face the stack, hold the frame and hinge slightly forward.
Kick the working leg straight back, leading with the heel.
Finish with a short squeeze at the top, hips square and the lower back still.
Return in two seconds and exhale as you kick.
mistakes: Swinging the leg and arching the lower back.
Twisting the hips open.
Letting the stack touch between reps.

name: Hip abduction machine
cue: Push the pads out and keep your back against the seat.
howTo: Sit back with the pads on the outsides of your knees, feet on the plates and back flat.
Push the legs out to the sides as far as comfortable.
Finish with the outer hips squeezed and a one second hold.
Return in three seconds and breathe out as you open.
mistakes: Rocking the torso to heave the pads.
Dropping the knees in too fast.
Using a range so short it barely works.

name: Hip adduction machine
cue: Squeeze the pads together and keep the torso still.
howTo: Sit back with the pads on the insides of your knees and feet on the plates.
Bring the legs together until the pads meet.
Finish with a one second squeeze and the back still on the pad.
Open in three seconds and exhale as you close.
mistakes: Opening so wide that the hips strain.
Throwing the legs together with momentum.
Leaning forward off the back pad.

name: Cable pull-through
cue: Hinge back with the rope between your legs and snap the hips forward.
howTo: Face away from a low pulley with a rope between your legs, step forward until the cable is taut and hinge slightly.
Push the hips back so the hands go behind the legs and the hamstrings stretch.
Finish by driving the hips forward until you stand tall with glutes squeezed.
Take two seconds back and exhale as you stand.
mistakes: Squatting down instead of hinging.
Pulling with the arms instead of the hips.
Leaning back at the top.

name: Standing calf raise
cue: Rise as high as you can and pause at the top.
howTo: Stand with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pads on your shoulders, heels hanging free.
Lower the heels to a deep stretch, then rise as high as possible.
Finish with a one second squeeze at the top.
Take two seconds down, pause in the stretch, and breathe out as you rise.
mistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom.
Bending the knees to heave the weight.
Cutting the range short at the top.

name: Seated calf raise
cue: Press through the ball of the foot and hold the top.
howTo: Sit with the pad on your lower thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform.
Lower the heels to a deep stretch, then press up as high as possible.
Finish with a one second pause at the top.
Take two seconds down and exhale as you rise.
mistakes: Bouncing at the bottom of the rep.
Rushing through half reps.
Letting the knees drift together or apart.

name: Leg press calf raise
cue: Use the leg press with straight legs and push through the balls of the feet.
howTo: Sit on the leg press with legs nearly straight and the balls of your feet on the lower edge of the platform.
Let the heels sink for a deep stretch, then press the platform away by rising on the toes.
Finish with a one second squeeze and the knees soft, not locked.
Take two seconds down and exhale as you press.
mistakes: Locking the knees hard under load.
Bouncing out of the bottom.
Moving only a short range.

name: Single-leg dumbbell calf raise
cue: Stand on one foot on a step edge and rise high.
howTo: Stand on a step with the ball of one foot on the edge, hold a dumbbell in the same-side hand and a rail with the other.
Lower the heel below the step for a deep stretch.
Rise as high as you can and pause for a second at the top.
Take two seconds down and exhale as you rise, then switch sides.
mistakes: Bouncing instead of controlling the stretch.
Leaning on the rail to do the lifting.
Cutting the range short.

name: Plank
cue: Squeeze your glutes and ribs down so the body stays one straight line.
howTo: Rest on the forearms with elbows under the shoulders, feet hip width and the body straight.
Tuck the pelvis slightly, tighten the abs and squeeze the glutes.
Hold the line from head to heels without letting the hips sag or rise.
Breathe slowly through the nose and keep the neck neutral.
mistakes: Sagging the lower back toward the floor.
Piking the hips up high.
Holding the breath for the whole set.

name: Hanging knee raise
cue: Curl the pelvis up, not just the knees.
howTo: Hang from the bar with straight arms and shoulders pulled down.
Bring the knees up toward the chest while tilting the pelvis back.
Finish with the knees above the hips and the abs squeezed.
Lower in two seconds without swinging, and exhale as you lift.
mistakes: Swinging the body to get the legs up.
Using only the hip flexors and not curling the pelvis.
Dropping the legs fast on the way down.

name: Cable crunch
cue: Curl the ribs toward the hips, not the hips toward the floor.
howTo: Kneel facing a high pulley holding a rope beside your head, hips stacked over the knees.
Curl the torso down by rounding the spine, bringing the elbows toward the thighs.
Finish with the abs squeezed and the hips still.
Return slowly for two seconds and exhale as you crunch.
mistakes: Sitting back on the heels to move the weight.
Pulling with the arms rather than the abs.
Bending at the hips instead of rounding the spine.

name: Ab crunch machine
cue: Round forward and bring the ribs toward the pelvis.
howTo: Sit with the pads against your chest or behind your shoulders and your feet anchored.
Crunch forward by curling the spine and shortening the distance between ribs and hips.
Finish with the abs squeezed and the lower back rounded.
Return in two to three seconds and exhale as you crunch.
mistakes: Pulling with the arms and hips.
Using speed instead of control.
Setting the weight so heavy that the back cannot stay curled.

name: Ab wheel rollout
cue: Roll out only as far as you can keep the lower back flat.
howTo: Kneel on a pad holding the ab wheel under your shoulders, ribs down and the back slightly rounded.
Roll forward in a slow line until the body is nearly straight.
Finish by pulling the wheel back with the abs, hips staying over the knees.
Take three seconds out, breathe out as you return and stop before the back arches.
mistakes: Letting the lower back sag as the wheel rolls out.
Pulling with the arms rather than the abs.
Reaching out so far that you drop to the floor.

name: Pallof press
cue: Press out and resist the cable trying to twist you.
howTo: Stand side-on to a cable at chest height, feet hip width and the handle held at your chest.
Press the handle straight out until the arms are extended without letting the torso rotate.
Finish with a two second hold and ribs down.
Return slowly to the chest, breathe out as you press, and switch sides.
mistakes: Letting the torso twist toward the cable.
Leaning away to counter the weight.
Shrugging the shoulders up during the press.

name: Reverse crunch
cue: Curl the hips up off the floor, using the abs, not momentum.
howTo: Lie on your back with the knees bent over the hips and hands at your sides or under the glutes.
Curl the pelvis up and toward the ribs, lifting the hips off the floor.
Finish with the lower back slightly lifted and the abs squeezed.
Lower slowly for two to three seconds and exhale as you curl.
mistakes: Swinging the legs to throw the hips up.
Using the hands to push off the floor.
Dropping the hips quickly on the way down.
